review: If I want to spend my time playing Echoes+ for FREE, then damnit I will. Not much to speak of graphically. Sound is reduced to not much more than a low (SUBWOOFER!) rumble. The action is blistering and relentless. Beat your high- score, if you are good enough.
很好玩的双摇杆射击游戏。免费的玩了一下感觉不错！

Aside from the obvious plus point that this is free, this game manages to both flow smoothly and to play well - even on my laptop, which runs other games like this at 2-5fps. I really recommend this game to anyone who likes hard but fair games and anyone who likes to upgrade and collect and, of course, have a good time.

The 5 different game modes all have their charms and all have a vibrant array of colours.

Yet again, really really recommend
